hook.en: On result day, a results website crashes because lakhs of students open it at once. Now imagine attackers doing that on purpose, with thousands of hijacked computers. That is a DDoS attack.
hook.kn: ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ದಿನ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಒಮ್ಮೆಗೇ ತೆರೆದಾಗ ಜಾಲತಾಣ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ದಾಳಿಕೋರರು ಸಾವಿರಾರು ವಶಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಇದನ್ನು ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅದೇ DDoS ದಾಳಿ.

narration.en: On result day, a results website crashes because lakhs of students open it at once. Now imagine attackers doing that on purpose, with thousands of hijacked computers. That is a DDoS attack.

body.en: A hacker is a person with deep knowledge of computers and networks who finds weaknesses in them. Ethical (white-hat) hackers do this with the owner’s permission to find and fix security holes before criminals do. Crackers, or black-hat hackers, break into systems illegally to steal data, cause damage or demand money. Grey-hat hackers find weaknesses without permission but without malicious intent, which is still not legal. Weak passwords are one of the easiest ways in for a cracker.

points.en: White hat: with permission, to fix weaknesses
Grey hat: no permission, no malice: still not legal

narration.kn: ನೈತಿಕ (ಬಿಳಿ ಟೋಪಿ) ಹ್ಯಾಕರ್‌ಗಳು ಮಾಲೀಕರ ಅನುಮತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ದೋಷಗಳನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಕರ್‌ಗಳು (ಕಪ್ಪು ಟೋಪಿ) ಅಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಒಳನುಗ್ಗಿ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title.en: On the board: DoS and DDoS

say.en: In a DoS attack, one attacker floods a server with requests.
In a DDoS attack, the attacker controls many infected computers called zombies, a botnet.
All the zombies hit the target server at once. Genuine users cannot get through.
Snooping secretly captures and analyses network traffic; eavesdropping listens in on a private conversation in real time.

narration.en: We draw a single attacker, then a botnet, and see why a distributed attack is so hard to stop.

prompt.en: Match each term with what it describes.

right.en: Tests a bank's system with permission to fix weak spots
Breaks in illegally to steal data or demand money
Finds weaknesses without permission but without malice; still not legal
One source floods a server with requests until genuine users are refused
A botnet of many zombie computers floods a server together
Capturing and analysing network traffic with a packet sniffer
Listening in on a private video call as it happens

explanation.en: Hackers differ in permission and intent. DoS comes from one source and DDoS from a botnet; snooping and eavesdropping capture traffic or conversations, and encryption is the main protection.
explanation.kn: ಹ್ಯಾಕರ್‌ಗಳು ಅನುಮತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರೆ. DoS ಒಂದು ಮೂಲ, DDoS ಬಾಟ್‌ನೆಟ್. ಗೂಢಲಿಪೀಕರಣ ಮುಖ್ಯ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ.

body.en: A Denial of Service (DoS) attack floods a server or network with so many requests that its resources run out and genuine users are denied service. In a Distributed DoS (DDoS) attack the flood comes from many compromised computers, called zombies, that form a botnet under the attacker’s control; it is hard to block because the traffic comes from everywhere. Snooping is the secret capture and analysis of network traffic, for example with packet-sniffing tools. Eavesdropping is unauthorised real-time interception of a private communication such as a phone call, video conference or chat. Encryption is the main protection against both.

points.en: DoS: one source exhausts the server
DDoS: a botnet of zombies attacks together

Snooping is the secret capture and analysis of network traffic, for example with packet-sniffing tools. narration.kn: DoS ದಾಳಿ ಸರ್ವರ್ ಅನ್ನು ವಿನಂತಿಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿಸಿ ನಿಜವಾದ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ಸೇವೆ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. DDoS ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನೇಕ ಜೊಂಬಿ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ದಾಳಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಸ್ನೂಪಿಂಗ್ ಸಂಚಾರವನ್ನು ಸೆರೆಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಈವ್ಸ್‌ಡ್ರಾಪಿಂಗ್ ನೈಜ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕದ್ದು ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: How long would a brute-force attack take?

caption.en: A cracker who tries every password needs up to c to the power L guesses, where c is the number of possible characters and L the length. Here the attacker tries ten billion guesses per second.

tryThis.en: Keep c = 26 and raise L from 8 to 12. How much longer does the attack take?
Keep L = 8 and change c from 26 to 94. Which change helps more?
Why is a long passphrase better than a short complex password?

caption.en: Every web connection starts with a TCP handshake. A server can hold only a limited number of half-open connections, so a flood of fake connection requests is one way to cause denial of service.

tryThis.en: Watch the three-way handshake: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK.
What happens to the server if thousands of SYNs arrive and no ACK ever follows?

narration.en: Every web connection starts with a TCP handshake. A server can hold only a limited number of half-open connections, so a flood of fake connection requests is one way to cause denial of service. Watch the three-way handshake: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK. What happens to the server if thousands of SYNs arrive and no ACK ever follows?

problem.en: Identify the threat: (a) A college admission portal stops responding because 20,000 infected home computers send it requests at once. (b) An attacker on the same café Wi-Fi records all unencrypted traffic and studies it later. (c) A security firm is hired by a bank to break into its own website and report weaknesses. (d) Someone secretly listens to a video interview as it happens.

steps.en: (a) Many compromised computers flooding one server → DDoS
(c) With permission, to fix weaknesses → ethical (white-hat) hacking
(d) Real-time interception of a private conversation → eavesdropping

narration.en: Ask: is it many sources or one, live or recorded, with permission or without?

narration.en: Recap. Ethical hackers work with permission; crackers break in illegally. DoS floods a server; DDoS uses a botnet of zombies. Snooping captures traffic; eavesdropping listens in real time. Long passwords and encryption are strong defences.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವಲೋಕನ. ನೈತಿಕ ಹ್ಯಾಕರ್‌ಗಳು ಅನುಮತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ; ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಕರ್‌ಗಳು ಅಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ. DoS ಸರ್ವರ್ ಅನ್ನು ತುಂಬಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; DDoS ಜೊಂಬಿ ಬಾಟ್‌ನೆಟ್ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ನೂಪಿಂಗ್ ಸಂಚಾರ ಸೆರೆಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಈವ್ಸ್‌ಡ್ರಾಪಿಂಗ್ ನೈಜ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಉದ್ದದ ಪಾಸ್‌ವರ್ಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಗೂಢಲಿಪೀಕರಣ ಬಲವಾದ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ.
